insertions.purpose: Stage the production appearance fixture before APK compilation.
Retain actual settings host text and JSON diagnostics even when the preceding check fails.
insertions.inserted:
- name: Preserve settings host diagnostics
      if: always()
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
      with:
        name: network-settings-host-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
        path: |
          work/gecko-integration/network-settings-*.txt
          work/gecko-integration/network-settings-*.json
        if-no-files-found: warn
        retention-days: 7
insertions.after: - name: Verify recovery, diagnostics and download publication boundaries

insertions.purpose: Run the additional webpage appearance bridge fixture and publish its original diagnostics for the UI phase.
insertions.inserted:
- name: Verify webpage appearance receipts through the actual Gecko bridge
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        exec > >(tee -a work/gecko-integration/native-test.log) 2>&1
        result=0
        python3 tools/gecko/generate_appearance_fixture.py
        python3 tools/gecko/generate_appearance_fixture.py --verify
        python3 tests/gecko/run_appearance_web.py --adb "$(command -v adb)" --serial emulator-5554 --apk app/build/outputs/apk/integration/app-x86_64-integration.apk || result=$?
        python3 tools/gecko/publish_ci.py
        exit "$result"
      if: ${{ !cancelled() && matrix.phase == 'ui' && steps.android_boot.outcome == 'success' }}
insertions.after: - name: Verify production environments and file transfers
